title: Who Malenia was really waiting for in Elden Ring
subject: malenia
description:
Did Malenia deserve to see Miquella again? 👇

What Malenia's famous speech is really about, and the brother who never came back to the Haligtree. Spoilers for Elden Ring and Shadow of the Erdtree.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FromSoftware or Bandai Namco Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Before Malenia fights you, she tells you what she's been waiting for.
In Elphael, she says, "I dreamt for so long. My flesh was dull gold, and my blood, rotted."
"Corpse after corpse, left in my wake, as I awaited his return."
That's Miquella. Fans believe Mohg, Lord of Blood, stole his sleeping body during her war.
Shadow of the Erdtree, the 2024 expansion, showed where he went. He never came back.
Then she rises: "I am Malenia, Blade of Miquella. And I have never known defeat."
Beat her, and she dies guarding the tree her brother left behind.
